comparison: The bounded Java TypeIdentity fixture agrees on equality for repeated concrete parameterizations and inequality for different type arguments. Java object-reference identity, full System.Type behavior, CLR reified generics, type loading and public API mapping remain unverified.
limits: Independent oracle, not an upstream xUnit test.
Only one generic definition and two closed argument combinations were exercised.
The Java helper is internal and rejects wildcard/type-variable forms.
